release_source_review.scope: Reconcile fourteen changed source pins and exact anchors after semantic review. The original captured date, static validation receipt, six historical benchmark rows, comparator identities and no-conversion decisions are retained.
changes: Cx adds published_cancel_requested and is_cancelled as Acquire readers of the stable cancellation bit. The locked is_cancel_requested query and checkpoint compatibility semantics remain distinct; direct legacy field mutation need not publish the stable bit.

TaskInspector and Diagnostics now use RuntimeStateSource: detached Owned views retain their old behavior, while Shared views lock RuntimeState, external tasks and external obligations in B -> A -> C order. RuntimeState::snapshot itself still reads the embedded tables. The earlier embedded-only observer finding is superseded for live inspector/diagnostics views.

Native workers now retain stored futures in the execution guard and destroy terminal futures outside owner locks, while the task Cx remains installed, before auditing completion. Completion revokes obligation admission and drains accepted posts while the holder remains live before detaching its record. Detached sharded records are still dropped rather than recycled.

ThreeLane current-thread dispatch can lend its worker across caller threads; each dispatch-loop entry scopes the local queues, spawn-lane owner and per-runtime local-store key. Missing thread-affine futures retain a stranded wake until their owning thread drives the worker. These paths are not represented by the old synthetic task-state benchmark.

The actor graceful-drain repair retains the cancellation writer sites. Lab additions provide region-command admission and optional production-schedule replay without replacing the quota writer. Oneshot adds obligation-aware permits and checked admission, and extracts its tests; its cancellation registration and post-lock wake contract remain separate from scheduler timing.

Cargo changes cover release versions/packaging, opt-in features, CLI logging, lint policy and resolved dependency updates. Existing TaskPhaseCell, TaskWakeState and CxCancellationState ownership primitives remain the incumbents; no synchronization replacement is authorized.
release_source_review.no_claim_boundary: This review updates the source inventory only. It does not establish scheduler equivalence, new performance observations, runtime correctness, broad workspace health or release readiness. Later focused contract execution is separate from the original static-only validation_state.

validation_state.reason: HOTREAD-1 is a static source, ownership, lifetime, and comparator specification. Executable validation and measurement belong to later beads.
